role: Frozen expanded development matrix for continuous route guidance with camera-only avoidance.

sensor_settings.calibration: Positive: median leave-one-out teaching-code overlap. Negative: median overlap for +/-60 degree teaching rotations at up to 12 evenly spaced stations. Clip linear confidence to [0,1]; minimum range .05.
sensor_settings.timing: Both controllers pay for every observed view, physical yaw excursion and translation. No observations or turns past shared time/sensory budgets.
sensor_settings.limitations: Finite-rate piecewise turns and straight moves; no full body dynamics, optic-flow controller or continuous spiking state.

evaluation.termination: Endpoint .2 m, 200 movement steps, field boundary or conservative rock collision.

calibration: Fixed pairwise teaching-code spread; no additional calibration images.
fixed: Same RGB 199x51, teaching images, encoder checkpoints, spiking circuit, memory, navigation settings and budgets as original smoke.
inference: Descriptive paired development results; phase and wiring repeats are not independent worlds.
advance: User authorized the full suite after the continuous-guidance smoke tests.
changed: No navigator restart or suspension. Matched-gaze familiarity changes describe the actual combined route/reflex movement. Its command path and net direction are recorded; cast counters continue normally. Original 16 cm reflex settings retained.
comparison: All three image frontends use the identical continuous controller, reflex, teaching images and resource budgets. Original studies remain separate.
physics: Original conservative rock discs retained for failure checks only, never provided to avoidance. No depth, labels, rangefinder or contact signal.
limitation: Three existing development environments, including scenes used to develop the controller. Seeds and phases are repeated measures, not independent environments. No significance or held-out generalization claim.
metrics: Path-weighted deviation over all executed substeps, including partial final moves; historical metric was equally weighted 10 cm endpoints. Arrival is directly comparable but computational costs differ.
primary_endpoint: Nest arrival without physics corrections; report all failures and costs.
scheduling: One append-only worker per world. Recompute all trials, including cached smoke conditions. Freeze all settings before outcomes.

analysis.primary: Nest arrival across every scheduled trial, including invalid releases and imposed kicks.
analysis.pairing: Average the two phases within world/seed/scenario, then average paired seed/scenario differences within each world.
analysis.intervals: Exact world bootstrap (27 size-three samples). Descriptive with only three worlds.
analysis.perturbation: Imposed kicks are external disturbances, excluded from walked distance. A matched-gaze comparison spanning a kick includes its visual consequences; the controller receives no kick notification.
analysis.success: Unchanged 20 cm endpoint radius, evaluated at macro-step boundaries. Report all failures; no parameter tuning during the suite.
